verified_meta_meaning: Local byte hash, parseability, owner, row-count/uniqueness/valid positions and requested limit. No original completeness or freshness proof. There is no literal Meta.verify boolean.

canonical_flow.fact: readVerifiedArchive validates meta/hash/rows/owner but accepts null readReceipt.
hasTrades only requires positive verified count, no history end receipt.
tradesCsv rejects missing/empty verifiedArchive; does not reject null receipt.
Metrics honestly expose history total/complete/download time as null without receipt.
Negative API totalElements throws before publishing a new HistoryDownload.
Provider download failure logs/counts error; no persisted per-provider failed-refresh export state.

contract_counterposition.fact: History end is explicitly an additional paging diagnostic, separate from input integrity and forensic gates. Legacy readability is intentional. A new unconditional end-receipt requirement would change the existing REST contract.

tests_reviewed.fact: Valid marker/hash makes hasTrades true without receipt; damage makes false.
Explicitly tests readable untouched flat legacy archive.
REST fixture stores verified trades without history receipt; CSV succeeds.
Unknown history diagnostics null is tested, independently of local verified trade rows.

gap: Fresh liveabschluss could mistake a successful historical CSV GET for a successful current download when it ignores null HistoryReceipt and preceding provider errors. The API does not literally claim tradeHistoryAvailable=true; that field is absent. Concrete exposure is HTTP200 stale bytes.
smallest_safe_option_now: Use the completed SHA-bound exact178 scope; keep 429230/430893 excluded. Preserve old CSV/meta bytes and label them stale after failed fresh download. No deployment is needed.
durable_option_for_separate_change: Expose persistent per-provider last refresh attempt/result separately from archive integrity, and enforce a requested fresh-snapshot export mode against the SHA-bound successful receipt/generation. Existing historical-read mode can remain explicit and stale-labelled. If choosing to require a receipt in every normal CSV/JSON export, treat it as an intentional contract change and update tests, rather than silently redefining hasTrades.
no_new_gate: Do not turn TradesHistoryComplete into a global forensic green gate or require downloaded==total. API end still is not an atomic snapshot completeness proof.
missing_combined_regression: No inspected test composes valid flat legacy archive + failed fresh negative-total request + normal REST GET. Existing tests intentionally allow the first and unknown paging metrics.
